description:
Commits the untimed peak resident memory record of each benchmark arm process.

## Background

The gf2 arms of the LDPC batch decoder and the AFF3CT arms [Cassagne2019] are built or catalogued under `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/survey/arms/` and `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/survey/arms.json`. Their build identity is recorded under `dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/preparation/`. The lane route keeps eight frames of decoder state per worker, and a timed receipt carries no memory figure of its own arm.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/preparation/peak-memory.json` gives the peak resident memory of each arm process on each recorded code, observed by one method over repeated launches, with its sample count and spread and a floor that bounds the launcher's share.
- [hard] REQ-02: The record is written by a committed recorder, names each arm by digest, and labels the figure as process memory, not decoder-owned memory.

## Notes

Source references: [Cassagne2019].
title: Record the peak memory of the benchmark arms
